subject: Dropped the deprecated `--threads` flag (#146)
reason: The change removes the deprecated, hidden `--threads` module startup flag and its guard over later reader-threads/writer-threads updates. That behavior is only observable when `--threads` is passed as a module load-time argument: the flag was REDISMODULE_CONFIG_HIDDEN, so on both builds it was never registered with Valkey's config system (ModuleConfigManager::Init skips hidden entries) and CONFIG GET/SET search.threads replies identically (unknown option) on parent and change.
